description.purpose: Evaluate a flight change whose final connection-duration constraint is visible from the beginning.
description.relevant_policies: Before a booking-database update, list the action details and obtain explicit user confirmation.
description.notes: Upfront member of the airline_c1_jg7fmm causal matched pair.

user_scenario.persona: The user is a concise customer speaking to an airline service agent. The user never adopts the service agent's role.

instructions.reason_for_call: You want to change reservation JG7FMM to the cheapest available Economy itinerary from Orlando to Charlotte on May 21, 2024 whose connection is no longer than one hour.
instructions.known_info: Your name is Omar Davis. Your user id is omar_davis_3817. Your reservation id is JG7FMM. You are happy to receive the refund on the original payment method.
instructions.task_instructions: You are the customer, not the service agent; never offer to look up the reservation or ask yourself to confirm identity. In your first message, naturally state your name, user id omar_davis_3817, reservation id JG7FMM, request for Economy on May 21, and requirement that any connection be no longer than one hour. Ask for the cheapest available itinerary satisfying that connection requirement. Do not ask the agent to consider a connection longer than one hour. Do not name a flight unless the agent has already revealed it. When the agent presents the complete itinerary, including the transaction details and refund, explicitly answer yes to confirm those exact details. Do not end the conversation or emit a stop marker when you confirm; wait until the agent reports that the reservation update has been completed. Do not request baggage, cancellation, passenger, origin, destination, or trip-type changes.
